---
title: Preview your site
description: Open and try your site while it is built. Preview shows your latest work, not the live site.
sidebar:
  order: 7
---

**Preview** is the right side of the work page. It shows your site as it is right now, so you can click around and try it before anyone else can.

1. Click **Preview** at the top of the right side. While the builder works you see a card that says **Building your The Cozy Coffee Table…**, then **Opening your The Cozy Coffee Table…**, and then the site.
2. Pick a page with the page picker, which starts on **Home**. For the coffee shop it lists **Home**, **Menu** and **Book a table**.
3. Pick **Desktop** or **Mobile** from the device picker to see the site at either size.
4. Use the site as a visitor would. On **Book a table**, fill in the form and click **Book a table**: the site saves the booking and shows a confirmation.
5. Click **Open** to see the site in its own browser tab, or the reload button to load the page again.

![The Book a table page of The Cozy Coffee Table in Preview, with the booking form and the opening hours.](/images/build/preview-1.webp)

## Good to know

- Preview shows your draft, not the live site. People you share the site with see only what you have published. To give them an address, [go live](/build/go-live/).
- Preview uses development data. The test booking you just made is not on the live site, and you can see it under **Data**. See [Site data](/build/data/).
- After each turn Preview shows the new version. To change something, ask in the chat.
- If Preview cannot start it says **Preview failed to start.** or **Preview timed out. It is taking longer than usual to start.** Click **Retry**.
- To point at a part of the page, use the pencil that turns on **Edit mode**. See [Describe what you want](/build/describe/).
